description: This Java interface defines a specialized set called Permissions, which holds Permission objects and can be represented as JSON. It includes static factory methods, schema version information, and methods for JSON serialization. It is part of the org.eclipse.ditto.model.things package, relating to permissions management within the Ditto framework.

classes.name: Permissions
classes.description: A set interface for Permission objects that can be serialized to JSON, supporting API versioning and permission checks.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new mutable Permissions instance containing specified permissions.

methods.name: getSupportedSchemaVersions
methods.description: Returns the supported JSON schema versions; only version V_1 is supported.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if the set contains specified permission(s); all must be present for true.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the permissions set to a JSON object including non-hidden marked fields.

methods.name: toJson (overloaded)
methods.description: Serializes the permissions to JSON according to a specific schema version and field selector.
